verdict.rationale: smolagents is itself an official, well-documented Python SDK from Hugging Face with extensive first-party docs (guided tour, tool-building tutorials, memory/callbacks, multiagent orchestration) and a public GitHub repo showing agent construction, push_to_hub/from_hub, and broad LLM/tool interoperability (LiteLLM, MCP, LangChain). Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking or case studies validating SDK stability beyond community anecdotes.
